name: branding-cartoon-artist-mascot-with-beret-palette-and-brush
title: Chibi artist mascot in a brown beret holding a brush and palette
whatItIs: A small square icon on pale blue of a big-headed cartoon kid in a brown beret, scarf and blue sweater, holding a paintbrush up and a wooden palette with paint dots, drawn with thick dark outlines.
whatItMeans: Friendly and approachable; the chibi proportions make a creative service feel fun and accessible.
techniques: Exaggerate head size for instant cuteness.
Use a thick uniform outline to keep it legible at icon size.
Give the character one prop that states its role.
Set it on a flat pale background for clean reuse.

vocabulary.definition: A cute style with a big head and small body.
A character that personifies a brand.
